# Bookkeeping App FY2027

**Team:** Product · **Period:** FY2027 · **Author:** Head of Product · **Status:** Active · **Version:** 1.0.0

## Vision

Every small business closes its books in an hour a month.

**Mission:** We take the busywork out of bookkeeping so owners can run their business.

## Strategy

### 1. Get new accounts to a reconciled month in their first week

**Owner:** Head of Onboarding · **Priority:** P0

Most new accounts that leave never reconcile a month. Connecting a bank is where they stall, so the first week is built around it.

**Resources**

- Engineering: 2 squads
- Design: 1 designer
- Bank connection fees: Included in the platform budget

**Execution**

| Work | Kind | Owner | Timing | Status |
|------|------|-------|--------|--------|
| Guided bank import<br>Walk new accounts through connecting a bank, with a fallback to a file upload when the connection fails. | initiative | Onboarding squad | 2027-01-04 to 2027-03-26 | In Progress |
| First reconciled month walkthrough | initiative | Onboarding squad | 2027-03-29 to 2027-06-25 | Planned |

**Metrics**

| Metric | Accountable | Baseline | Target | Current | Due | Status |
|--------|-------------|----------|--------|---------|-----|--------|
| New accounts that connect a bank in their first session | Head of Onboarding | 45% | 70% | 51% | 2027-06-30 | On Track |

### 2. Make weekly reconciliation a habit

**Owner:** Head of Core Product · **Priority:** P1

Accounts that reconcile weekly stay. Reminders and a faster review screen make the weekly session short.

**Resources**

- Engineering: 1 squad
- Lifecycle marketing: 20% of the email team

**Execution**

| Work | Kind | Owner | Timing | Status |
|------|------|-------|--------|--------|
| Weekly reconciliation reminders | program | Lifecycle marketing | from 2027-01-04 | In Progress |
| Faster transaction review screen | initiative | Core squad | 2027-04-05 to 2027-07-30 | Planned |

**Metrics**

| Metric | Accountable | Baseline | Target | Current | Due | Status |
|--------|-------------|----------|--------|---------|-----|--------|
| Connected accounts that reconcile weekly | Head of Core Product | 30% | 50% | 31% | 2027-12-31 | At Risk |

### 3. Bring owners in through their accountants

**Owner:** Head of Partnerships · **Priority:** P2

Accountants who manage several clients invite them and keep them reconciling.

**Resources**

- Partner managers: 2 people
- Partner program budget: 15% of the marketing budget

**Execution**

| Work | Kind | Owner | Timing | Status |
|------|------|-------|--------|--------|
| Accountant partner program | program | Partnerships | from 2027-02-01 | Planned |

**Metrics**

| Metric | Accountable | Baseline | Target | Current | Due | Status |
|--------|-------------|----------|--------|---------|-----|--------|
| New accounts invited by an accountant | Head of Partnerships | 0 accounts | 2,000 accounts |  | 2027-12-31 |  |
